name: fault-language-support
description: Syntax highlighting and language support for the Fault specification language

fault-linter.debounceTime.description: Debounce time in milliseconds for linting on document changes

fault-linter.rules.missing-semicolon.description: Missing semicolon at end of statement

fault-linter.rules.missing-comma.description: Missing trailing comma in stock/flow property

fault-linter.rules.invalid-flow-assignme.description: Flow assignments must use -> or <- operators

fault-linter.rules.missing-file-declarat.description: File must begin with spec/system declaration matching filename

fault-linter.rules.flow-scalar-property.description: Scalar value in flow property (causes compiler panic)

fault-linter.rules.directional-operator-.description: RHS of <- or -> should be a plain delta; arithmetic expressions are valid but not recommended

fault-linter.rules.state-builtin-in-fspe.description: stay()/advance()/leave() are only valid in .fsystem files

fault-linter.rules.invalid-identifier.description: Identifiers must be alphanumeric only (no underscores or hyphens)

fault-linter.rules.when-then-temporal.description: when/then invariants cannot have a temporal qualifier

fault-linter.rules.const-group-syntax.description: Grouped const blocks are not valid Fault syntax

fault-linter.rules.import-in-fspec.description: import can only be used in .fsystem files

fault-linter.rules.choose-misuse.description: choose requires two or more || alternatives of advance()/leave()/stay()

fault-linter.rules.wrong-file-type-globa.description: global declarations can only be used in .fsystem files

fault-linter.rules.wrong-file-type-compo.description: component declarations can only be used in .fsystem files

fault-linter.rules.wrong-file-type-impor.description: import can only be used in .fsystem files

fault-linter.rules.wrong-file-type-def.description: def declarations can only be used in .fspec files

fault-linter.rules.unfalsifiable-asserti.description: Asserting an already-assumed expression is unfalsifiable

fault-linter.rules.missing-run-block.description: .fspec file has no run block for the solver to execute

fault-linter.rules.empty-func-body.description: func{} body is empty and has no effect

fault-linter.rules.undeclared-stock-type.description: new StockType where StockType has no def declaration

fault-linter.rules.identical-branch-call.description: Both branches of an if/else call the same function

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
